title: Wobble Cat Treat Dispenser Toy, Interactive Tumbler Slow Feeder For Indoor Cats, Self-Balancing Puzzle Toy With Weighted Base, IQ Training & Boredom Relief, Cat Kitten Enrichment Toy
content:
All products we supply ship DDP.

Features：

  • TREAT DISPENSING FUN: Fill with kibble or treats. As your cat paws and pushes, treats fall out randomly, turning snack time into a rewarding hunt.
  • SELF-BALANCING TUMBLER: Built-in weighted iron ball keeps the toy upright. It wobbles 360° and always bounces back, no matter how hard your cat tips it.
  • SLOW FEEDER DESIGN: Releases food little by little to slow down fast eaters, helping prevent gulping, vomiting and overeating.
  • MENTAL & PHYSICAL STIMULATION: Sparkles natural foraging instincts, eases anxiety and boredom, and keeps indoor cats active and entertained all day.
  • SAFE & DURABLE MATERIALS: Made of food-grade PP and ABS with a smooth finish. Sturdy, bite-resistant and easy to rinse clean. Fits cats and kittens.

Description：
Make playtime rewarding. This wobble treat dispenser combines a tumbler toy and a slow feeder in one. Drop treats or dry kibble into the top opening, then watch your cat bat, roll and chase it. Every push makes it wobble and glide, and treats drop out at random to keep your cat guessing.

The secret is the weighted base. A built-in iron ball keeps the center of gravity low, so the toy self-rights after every tumble. It never lies flat, so the game never ends.

Specifications:

  • Material: PP + ABS + weighted iron ball
  • Size: 6.3 x 3.7 x 6.3 inches (16 x 9.3 x 16 cm)
  • Net weight: 7.2 oz / 205 g
  • Suitable for: cats and kittens of all ages

**Return & Refund Policy**

Returns are accepted only for quality issues. No refunds for failed deliveries caused by incorrect or incomplete customer-provided addresses.

The cat house combines sleeping, playing, and scratching in one. It is made of pet-friendly materials and comes with plush cushions. The double-sided cushions are suitable for all seasons.

The design includes a cozy condo and a spacious balcony with soft plush cushions. A cat can sleep comfortably in the cat hideout or rest on the spacious balcony, including on a sunny windowsill. The plush large open-hole is soft and allows cats to get in and out without friction.

For activity, the cat cube provides a durable scratching pad to entertain cats and promote healthy scratching habits. A round window and hanging ball add extra fun and help keep a cat active and engaged while providing a cozy resting spot.

The cat bed is made with reinforced thickened density board. The structure is intended to let cats jump and play without causing the cat house to collapse. The anti-slip design on the bottom helps prevent the cat bed from shaking easily.

The lightweight and foldable design allows compact storage and transportation. It can be moved around the house or taken when traveling. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.

title: 4 Tiers Outdoor Cat House Weatherproof Cat Tree Tower with Waterproof Roof and 2 Doors , Feral Cat Shelter Outside Enclosure, Multi-Level Play Zones with Balcony, for Small Animals, Grey
content:
• Spacious 4-Tier Outdoor Cat House: Designed with a tall 4-level structure, this outdoor cat tree provides plenty of vertical space for cats to climb, explore, nap, and observe their surroundings. The layered design creates separate areas for rest, play, and activity, making it ideal for multi-cat households.
  • 4 Climbing Ramps & Multiple Jump Platforms: Equipped with four climbing ramps and several jumping steps, this multi-level playground allows cats of different ages to easily move between levels. The gentle ramps make climbing safer while encouraging exercise and exploration.
  • Private Bottom Shelter with Curtain & Closing Door:The bottom level offers a cozy enclosed shelter with a curtain-style entrance and a closable door, creating a quiet and secure space for cats to rest or hide. This thoughtful design provides extra privacy and protection from outdoor elements.
  • Interactive Play Area with Scratching Post & Toy: The second level features a scratching post and a hanging fish toy, giving cats a dedicated place to scratch, stretch, and play. This helps satisfy natural instincts while keeping your cats engaged and entertained.
  • Safe and Convenient Indoor and Outdoor Activities: Simply place this outdoor cat tower near a window or cat door, and your beloved cat can freely come and go—sunbathing on the roof or exploring on the ramps, enjoying its own safe outdoor playground.
  • Weatherproof Roof: This cat house roof is made of durable, waterproof asphalt, effectively resisting rain and moisture. It ensures the interior of the cat house remains dry and comfortable in all weather conditions.
  • Solid Pine Wood Core Scratching Posts for Long-Lasting Use: Unlike cardboard or hollow tubes, our scratching posts feature a pine wood core that offers superior durability and stability. Built to withstand daily scratching, it won’t easily deform or collapse over time.
  • Sturdy Wooden Construction: Crafted from solid pine wood with a clean gray finish, this cat house blends beautifully into outdoor spaces. The reinforced frame ensures stability and durability for long-term use.

  • Weight Capacity：66lbs
  • Material：Pine Wood + Asphalt
  • Assembly Time：1 hour

title: Dual-Head Hair Remover
content:
Dual-Head Electric Hair Trimmer Instruction Manual

Page 1 Product Introduction

Thank you for choosing our company's dual-head electric hair trimmer. This product features a unique dual-head design, with one end equipped with a clipper head specially designed for smoothly trimming long hair, and the other end fitted with a floating dual-ring round head, capable of closely adhering to the skin to efficiently remove short hair. It adopts an innovative design with dual heads and dual motors, offers 7-level waterproof functionality, and operates safely and quietly, providing a novel experience for your personal grooming.

Component Description

①Length-Limiting Comb Teeth
②Clipper Head
③Type-C Charging Port
④Power Switch
⑤Indicator Light
⑥Dual-Ring Floating Head
⑦Protective Cover
⑧Cleaning Brush
⑨Charging Cable

Note: This product contains a built-in lithium battery. Please be sure to operate in accordance with the instructions provided in the manual.
Page 2 Component Disassembly Instructions

The following illustrations and text are intended as a guide for operations:

1. Remove the limit comb
Slide the side of the comb teeth to loosen and then remove the limit comb.

2. Remove the clipper blade head
Push the blade teeth backwards, loosen and then remove the clipper blade head.

3. Remove the rotary blade head
Twist the rotary blade head counter-clockwise until it loosens, then remove it.

4. Remove the rotary blade and screen
Twist the four pillars on the white fixing part inside the blade head. Once loosened, remove the fixing part, blade, and screen.
Page 3

Indicator Light Status Description
No. Item Status
1 Clipper Head Working Red and Blue Light Stay On
2 Round Head Working Blue Light Stays On
3 Low Battery Warning Indicator Light Blinks
4 Charging Red Light Blinks (Breathes)
5 Charge Complete Red Light Stays On

Specifications
No. Item Unit Specification
1 Operating Voltage V 3.7-4.2
2 Operating Current mA 400
3 Power W 2
4 Waterproof Level / IPX7
5 Battery Capacity mAh 400
6 Charging Current mA 400
7 Charging Time H 2
8 Size mm 1673332
9 Weight g 138

Page 4 Precautions

Contraindications

1. Not for use by children.

2. Do not use on facial skin that is injured or severely acne-prone.

3. Avoid excessive movement or prolonged use during operation.

4. Do not remove the blade head while the device is working.

Storage Requirements

Do not expose the product to high-temperature environments.
Keep away from corrosive liquids.
Store the product out of reach of children.

Please do not leave the product unattended when it is in operation.
Do not attempt to disassemble the main unit yourself.
If the blade head is damaged, discontinue use immediately.
If the product is dropped or hit hard, check for damage before continuing use.
Page 5 Guidance for Usage

Usage Instructions: The following are illustrated instructions for using this device:

1. Press and hold the "On/Off" button for 2 seconds to select the clipper mode for trimming long hair.

2. Use the serrated clipper head against the direction of hair growth to trim longer hairs.

3. Press briefly once more to activate the round head shaving mode.

4. Use the dual-ring rotary head against the direction of hair growth, making circular motions to shave off short hairs.

5. After use, press and hold the "On/Off" button for 2 seconds to turn the device off.

6. Remove the used blade head to clean the hair from the storage area.
Page 6 Troubleshooting
Fault Symptom Cause Analysis Solutions
The main unit is not working (blue light turns on then off) Overload causing the circuit system to protect and forcibly shut down 1. Reinstall the round head blade and check if the white fixture is installed backwards.
2. Remove the round head to see if there is any foreign object blocking the blade.
3. If the above attempts do not work, please contact after-sales service.
The main unit is not working (blue and red lights turn on then off) Overload causing the circuit system to protect and forcibly shut down 1. Remove the clipper head to check if any foreign objects are jamming the blade.
2. If the above attempts do not work, please contact after-sales service.
The main unit is not working (no response) Insufficient battery 1.Use after charging.
2.If the above attempts do not work, please contact after-sales service.

title: Male Dog Physiological Pants Are Reusable And Washable For Dogs With Diapers
content:
Ensure your male dog stays comfortable, clean, and confident with this premium Washable Dog Belly Band. Designed for pet owners seeking a practical and eco-friendly alternative to disposable diapers, this Male Dog Diaper offers superior leak-proof protection while maintaining breathability and style. Whether your furry friend is dealing with incontinence, marking habits, or recovering from surgery, this Dog Sanitary Pants provides a secure and hygienic solution for daily wear.

Crafted from high-quality, durable fabric with a breathable mesh exterior, this belly band promotes excellent airflow to prevent overheating and skin irritation. The soft, absorbent inner lining effectively locks in moisture, keeping your pet dry and protecting your furniture, carpets, and floors from accidents. The ergonomic design features a strong hook-and-loop fastener (magic tape) for easy adjustment, ensuring a snug yet comfortable fit around your dog's waist without restricting movement. Available in versatile colors like classic grey and warm yellow-brown, it suits various breeds from small Bichons to medium-large Golden Retrievers.

title: Leopard Wash Denim Military Jacket & Wide-Leg Pants Set
content:
Hero Hook

Unleash high-street rock-'n'-roll attitude with military-inspired tailoring. Crafted in acid-washed ocean blue cotton denim, this head-turning two-piece set features an all-over feline leopard motif pattern. The cropped jacket is anchored by double-breasted metallic dome buttons and horizontal cord braiding, paired with matching relaxed high-waisted wide-leg jeans for an unforgettable, cohesive statement look.

Key Features

  • Distressed Leopard Acid-Wash Pattern: Unique bleached leopard rosette print delivering a cool Y2K vintage vibe.

  • Military Drummer-Jacket Braiding: Dual placket panels lined with metallic silver dome buttons and horizontal corded braiding.

  • Structured Cropped Fit: High-cut Mandarin collar jacket designed to accentuate the waistline.

  • Relaxed Wide-Leg Trousers: High-rise, straight-to-wide leg jeans completing the monochromatic co-ord set.

  • With Android 11.0 has a built-in operating system, allowing it to function as a stand-alone device.
  • It comes with BT 5.0 function, which supports stable connection to various BT speakers, you can enjoy music with your own BT specker.

  • Projectors also provide automatic horizontal keystone correction and manual trapezoidal correction. By combining two functions, you will get better viewing experience, better image quality.
  • Built-in screen mirroring function, supports Miracast, Airplay, DLNA. Mirror your screen from anywhere!
  • With surprisingly powerful audio so you don't need to buy external sound system for this projector. Taking you on an unforgettable musical journey.
  • The projector offers a projection size of 40"-200" with a projection distance between 4.9ft-18.4ft, you can get the best viewing size by manual adjustment.
  • Multi-device connection. Built-in HD, AV, USB, 3.5mm headphone port, plus included HD cable, TV Stick/Box connection, game consoles, PCs, smartphones, tablets, laptops and USB pen drives.


Package Included:
